notes: Google Sheets web UI (path /spreadsheets/d/...). The grid is canvas-rendered, so we drive it through the name box (#t-name-box), the rich-text editor (#waffle-rich-text-editor), the formula bar (#t-formula-bar-input), and synthetic clipboard events. /sheets_info FIRST to confirm you're on a spreadsheet and to learn the current selection / sheet tabs. /sheets_write_range pastes an HTML <table> so newlines, commas, em-dashes, and quotes inside cells are preserved (verified). Tools that touch the doc are persisted to Drive within ~1s but the on-screen render may lag — pair with a short /wait_for or re-read via /sheets_read_cell if you need confirmation. These tools are spreadsheet-only; for Docs / Slides you'll need a different profile.

tools.description: Return the current spreadsheet's state: document title, active sheet gid, active cell or selection (from name box), list of sheet tabs, and the URL. Cheap; call first to orient. Returns { error } if not on a /spreadsheets/d/* URL.

Jump to a cell or range (e.g. 'A1', 'C5:F12', 'Sheet2!A1'). Drives the name box. Returns the post-jump selection. Use this before /sheets_write_range or /sheets_clear_range when you want to be explicit about where you're writing.

Read the value of a single cell by navigating to it and reading the formula bar. Returns the displayed value (or the formula source if it's a formula). For bulk reads, call multiple times or rely on the user exporting the sheet — there's no native multi-cell read because the grid is canvas-rendered.

Write a 2D array of values starting at the given top-left cell. Builds an HTML <table> and pastes it via a synthetic ClipboardEvent — Sheets parses the table and fills cells row-by-row. Newlines, commas, em-dashes, and quotes inside cells are preserved (verified round-trip). Values are coerced to strings; pass formulas as their literal '=SUM(A1:A3)' string and Sheets will interpret them on paste. Each row must have the same column count. Returns the post-paste selection (typically the full range that was filled).

cell.description: Top-left cell in A1 notation, e.g. 'A1' or 'Sheet2!A1'

values.description: 2D array, outer = rows, inner = columns. e.g. [["h1","h2"],["r1c1","r1c2"]]

tools.description: Clear all values in a range (Delete-key behavior — preserves formatting). Equivalent to selecting the range and pressing Delete.
Rename the spreadsheet (the doc title shown in the top bar and used by Drive). Sheets persists asynchronously; document.title may take a second to reflect the change.

Click the '+' add-sheet button at the bottom-left to create a new sheet tab. Returns the new active sheet's name (Sheets auto-names it 'Sheet2', 'Sheet3', ...). To rename, use /sheets_rename_sheet (not yet implemented — would need menu interaction).
List all sheet tabs in the current document with their names and active state. Quick reference for /sheets_goto_cell when you need a cross-sheet reference like 'Sheet2!A1'.
tools.code:
const tabs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.docs-sheet-tab')).map((t, i) => ({ index: i, name: t.querySelector('.docs-sheet-tab-name')?.innerText ?? null, active: t.classList.contains('docs-sheet-active-tab') }));
return { count: tabs.length, sheets: tabs };
